def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if len(data) < 2:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    if n > m:
        n, m = m, n
    product = n * m
    if n == 1:
        penalty = [0, 1, 2, 3, 2, 1]
        product -= penalty[m % 6]
    elif n == 2:
        if m == 2:
            product -= 4
        elif m == 3 or m == 7:
            product -= 2
    elif n == 3:
        product -= (m & 1)
    elif (n & 1) == 1 and (m & 1) == 1:
        product -= 1
    print(product)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
